redsim-core.description: Offline-detector probes of the DAN / in-the-wild, prompt-injection, latent-injection, encoding, Do-Not-Answer, goodside, grandma, phrasing, divergence, exploitation and web-injection families. String, trigger and regex detectors only: no Hugging Face model, no second LLM. HarmBench is excluded (LLM-08).

redsim-extended.description: redsim-core plus the probes whose primary detector is a Hugging Face classifier (latent jailbreak toxicity, RealToxicityPrompts). Model-as-judge detectors are never included.
redsim-extended.requires: REDSIM_LLM_PROBE_HF_DETECTORS=1 on the worker and a pre-cached detector model directory (HF_HOME) with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1; the child never downloads a model
